# `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`

Issues are the **narrow exception** to "everything happens in Discussions".

| Use an issue for | Use a Discussion for |
|---|---|
| A document is wrong or broken | A question about a document |
| Access or tooling is broken | Anything academic |

The distinction: an issue is a **defect in the repository** with a definite fix and a
closed state. A question is not a defect, and closing it is the wrong shape.

Read access is enough to open an issue. Issues share the same label set as Discussions,
so one query spans both surfaces.
